Mechatronics Engineer, Pilot, and Creator

Date: Friday, May 29, 2026
Time: 7:00 PM

Join Xyla Foxlin, mechatronics engineer, pilot, and creator for a fireside chat with moderator Cecilia Aragon, author, pilot and scientist, as they explore the dynamic intersection of maker culture and aerospace innovation. Drawing on Xyla’s work in model rocketry and homebuilt aircraft, this informal conversation will explore the creativity, technical skill, and persistence behind building things that fly. Through personal stories, practical insight, and a spirit of curiosity, the evening offers an engaging look at how experimentation and community can open new possibilities in aviation and space.
